hero.title: Music at the heart.

controlRoom.label: Venue control room
controlRoom.note: Scheduled volume presets and supported integrations keep the behavior predictable. Beat Breeze does not claim continuous microphone-based ambient sensing.

day.title: The venue changes. The plan changes with it.
day.description: Schedules provide the backbone. Weather, prayer times and approved operational triggers can adjust the plan, while staff keep the final say.

morning.title: Morning starts by zone
morning.text: Lobby, breakfast and wellness zones open with distinct music, screen and volume presets.

weather.title: Weather informs the direction
weather.text: A hot or rainy day can influence playlist recommendations or configured behavior without taking control away from the operator.

prayer.title: Prayer time is respected
prayer.text: Configured markets can pause or change programming at the correct local prayer time, then return cleanly to the schedule.

evening.title: Evening activates the wider experience
evening.text: Music, visual loops, multilingual messages and preset volume behavior move into the evening plan together.

day.volumeNote: Volume changes described here are scheduled presets or supported venue-system integrations—not continuous microphone listening.

concierge.title: Ask for a result. Review what comes back.
concierge.description: Tell Concierge the zone, audience, time and desired feeling. It can recommend catalogue music or prepare a creative direction; you preview the result before anything plays or enters a schedule.
concierge.control: Human control stays visible: review the reasoning, preview the result, apply it, edit it or keep browsing the catalogue manually.

arrival.request: For the lobby from 16:00–19:00: warm, contemporary and calm during check-in. Avoid sleepy acoustic music.

campaign.label: Retail launch

recovery.label: Wellness recovery

recovery.result: Ambient soundscape with slow harmonic movement
recovery.reason: Long-form textures reduce noticeable transitions while leaving staff in direct control of level and timing.

media.title: Build the world around the soundtrack.

hero.subtitle: Commercial music rights vary by repertoire, product, territory and how music is used. BMAsia helps you understand the scope before you go live.

intro.paragraph1: A consumer streaming subscription is not the same as permission to play music in a business. Commercial use can involve several layers of rights.
intro.paragraph2Highlight: confirm the service and territory, in writing.

01.title: Recorded music rights
01.desc: Permission connected to the particular sound recording. Coverage depends on the catalogue and commercial music service you select.

02.title: Composition rights
02.desc: Rights connected to the underlying song, including songwriters and publishers. Product and territory determine how these are handled.

03.title: Public performance obligations
03.desc: A venue may also need a local licence or collecting-society arrangement. Requirements differ by country, venue and repertoire.

warning.label: A useful boundary
warning.quote: Use a business music service and verify the rights that apply to your exact venue.

evidence.title: Music works through context.
evidence.description: Research can help us ask better questions. It cannot replace the venue brief, listener needs or live validation.
evidence.opensSource: opens the research source in a new tab

brandFit.title: Fit before fame.
brandFit.body: Large field studies reported different behaviour when music matched the brand instead of relying on random popular tracks. We use that as a brief-setting signal, not a guaranteed sales formula.

exercise.title: Preference changes the experience.
exercise.body: A 2025 meta-analysis associated preferred music with motivation, affect and some strength and power outcomes, while varied results argue against one generic gym playlist.

care.title: Calm needs context and control.
care.body: A healthcare waiting-room review found promising anxiety and experience benefits, but methods and results varied. Suitability, volume and staff control remain part of the intervention.

focus.title: Focus music is not one category.
focus.body: A controlled study found different outcomes from two similarly marketed focus-music conditions. The sound must fit the task, audience and shared space.

items: Contact and business details, venue information, product preference and messages submitted through enquiry, quotation and Soundtrack trial forms.
Assistant conversations and escalation details when you choose to use the chat or voice experience.
Consent choice, language preference, device and usage information, referral data and approximate network information where optional measurement is enabled.

Depending on the context, our basis may be steps toward a contract, performance of a contract, legitimate business interests, consent, or a legal obligation.
items: Submitting a form is not permission for unrelated bulk marketing.
Optional analytics and prospect measurement load only after the consent choice shown on this site.
Assistant responses are informational and are not binding commercial commitments.

sharing.title: Services and recipients
paragraphs: We share data only where needed to operate the site, respond to you, arrange a requested service, or meet legal duties. Providers can process data in countries outside your own.
items: Render and Cloudflare for application, database, network and security infrastructure.
Google Workspace and Gmail for business correspondence; Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics when optional measurement is accepted.
Apollo website visitor measurement when optional measurement is accepted.

OpenAI and BMAsia assistant or message-hub services when text guidance or human escalation features are used; ElevenLabs if a voice feature is explicitly used; and Google Calendar, Microsoft Teams or Calendly when you request a demo booking.
Soundtrack when you request a Soundtrack trial or activation and the necessary setup details must be shared.
Professional advisers, authorities or counterparties where required by law or a legitimate corporate transaction.

retention.title: Retention and security
paragraphs: We keep information only for as long as needed for the purpose collected, an active business relationship, dispute handling, security, or legal and accounting obligations. Retention differs by record type and jurisdiction.
BMAsia and its providers use organisational and technical safeguards, but no internet transmission or storage system can be guaranteed completely secure.

rights.title: Your choices and rights
paragraphs: Depending on where you are, you may be able to request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability or objection, withdraw consent, and complain to a relevant data-protection authority. We may need to verify your identity and may retain information where law permits or requires it.
items: You can reopen cookie preferences from the footer or the link below.
You can ask us to stop a direct follow-up that is not required for a current service.
Browser and device controls may also limit cookies or permissions.

contact.title: Contact and updates
paragraphs: Email privacy questions or rights requests to the address below. We may update this policy when the site, providers or legal requirements change; the current date will appear at the top of this page.

cookies.title: Cookie and storage policy
cookies.summary: A plain-language map of the browser storage and optional measurement used on this website—and how to change your choice.

storage.title: Cookies and browser storage
paragraphs: Cookies are small values stored by a browser. This site also uses local storage for the consent record. Providers enabled by your choice may use their own cookies or similar identifiers.

necessary.title: Necessary storage
paragraphs: Necessary storage supports choices you ask the site to remember and is not used for advertising.
items: cookie_consent_v2 in local storage records whether you accepted only necessary storage or also optional measurement.
NEXT_LOCALE remembers the language you select. Its current maximum age is one year.
Essential security or platform controls may be set by the hosting and network layer.

optional.title: Optional measurement
paragraphs: If you accept optional measurement, the site loads Google Tag Manager and the configured Google Analytics measurement, plus Apollo website measurement. These providers may set identifiers such as _ga or Apollo-related cookies and use browser or network information to produce usage and prospect insights.
Exact provider cookie names and lifetimes can change. They are governed by the provider configuration and policies as well as your browser controls.

control.title: Give, refuse or withdraw consent
paragraphs: You can choose necessary storage only, accept optional measurement, or reopen the panel later. Withdrawing optional consent removes known Google Analytics and Apollo cookies that are accessible to this site and reloads the page so optional scripts are not loaded again. Browser settings can remove remaining provider storage.

providers.title: Provider boundaries
paragraphs: Google and Apollo process optional measurement under their own privacy terms. BMAsia does not intentionally load those measurement tools before the consent panel records acceptance. The assistant itself is an interactive service; information you actively send through it is covered by the privacy policy.

contact.title: Questions
